atoms.text: Yayoi Kusama is an artist, known for using dots in her colourful artwork. She was born on 22 March 1929 in Matsumoto, Japan. She began painting when she was very young. She is famous for covering surfaces, like the floor or objects, with dots. Yayoi Kusama’s art has been shown in museums around the world, including the Tate Modern in London.
